review_scope: Read saved JSON and frozen source; no NPZ/PT decode, model call, integration, fitting or gradient computation.
scientific_pass_interpretation: Valid execution plus separately inspected parameter, hidden-state and trajectory evidence; not a general identifiability or real-data claim.

parameter_evidence.conclusion: The fitted scalar agrees with the known value at the predeclared optimizer scale. The tiny same-step loss difference does not establish superiority to the physically correct parameter.

distinction.parameter: One shared stiffness is recovered in this fixed known-truth family; no global uniqueness claim.
distinction.hidden_state: Fitted start/origin hidden errors and history residuals pass the separate per-event gates in all three splits.
distinction.trajectory: All three fitted splits pass the three-second prediction gate; the recorded one/two/three/five/eight-second paired errors improve over the fixed 10 percent mismatch.
distinction.stability: Mismatch, known and fitted already classify all 64 events correctly. This run supports parameter/state/trajectory recovery, not improved classification accuracy.

evidence_consistency.checked: All 31 artifact hashes, 9 role reports, optimization ledger, confusion/coverage and paired metrics.
evidence_consistency.independent_reviewer_checks: Read full-result JSON, scalar/profile/freeze identities, all nine role summaries and the frozen scoring/selection source; independently read manifest and summary hashes.

boundaries.population: New deterministic clean analytic sine-L10, train32/val16/test16; all other dynamics fixed to their known values.
boundaries.test_role: Reporting only; not used to choose the next model or tune thresholds.
boundaries.route_basis: Preregistered synthetic parameter recovery, valid causal initialization and train/val trajectory evidence.
boundaries.next_requirements: Freeze one shared R20/R21 starting model, a consistent differentiable stiffness path, new exact budgets and full paired train346/val107/test76 evaluation before any new real-data execution.
